title: notifications/resources/updated params
description: Params Labby sends downstream when a subscribed upstream resource changes. Mirrors rmcp 3.1.0 ResourceUpdatedNotificationParam. Emitted by NotificationTarget::notify_resource_updated (crates/labby/src/mcp/peers.rs) after the fan-out predicate in catalog_notifications.rs:271-277 selects the session.

uri.description: Gateway-form URI of the changed resource — byte-identical to the string the client passed to resources/subscribe (contract C-10). Rewritten from the upstream's native URI by gateway_resource_uri() (crates/labby-gateway/src/upstream/pool/notifications.rs:140), except ui:// URIs which are carried natively.

$comment: Delivery is at-most-once (contract C-12). Loss modes: fan-out race, post-unsubscribe straggler, broadcast lag, delivery timeout, upstream removal. Clients needing stronger guarantees must re-read the resource.
